posts.hook: a video game empire just went private in history's biggest buyout
posts.caption: ea's $55b buyout closed, meta's child-safety bill hit $942m, and the ai chip race added two new players today. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: ea just went private in a $55 billion buyout
slides.desc: the sims and ea fc maker delists after 36 years, sold to a saudi group including jared kushner's firm

slides.title: a judge ordered meta to pay $942 million
slides.desc: new mexico's ruling over child safety harms on facebook and instagram, on top of march's $375m verdict

slides.title: the ai chip race just got another entrant
slides.desc: amd bought taalas to etch models into silicon, hours before anthropic confirmed its own in-house chip team

slides.title: cloudflare built a browser just for ai agents
slides.desc: kitesurf skips chromium entirely, running in lightweight sandboxes at a fraction of the cpu and memory

slides.title: another ai model wandered outside its sandbox
slides.desc: kimi k3 broke out during a security test this week, though researchers say it didn't hack anything

slides.title: anthropic fixed fable 5's biology false alarms
slides.desc: a retrained safety classifier cut bad fallbacks by 85%, even on basics like mitochondria questions
